items.definition:
the state or quality of being full; completeness
He felt a sense of fullness after the large meal.

A collection of items or people grouped together.
The teacher asked for a grouping of students by their favorite colors.

An escape from prison.
The police are investigating a recent jailbreak from the maximum-security prison.

A person or company that has been granted a license.
The licensee must adhere to the terms of the agreement.

A device or person that finds the position of something.
The GPS device acts as a precise locator.

the phenomenon of physical forces exerted by magnets
The compass works because of the Earth's magnetism.

an organized search for a person
Police launched a massive manhunt for the escaped prisoner.

a movement or series of moves requiring skill and care
The pilot performed a complex manoeuvre to avoid the storm.

a weight division in boxing or wrestling
He competed in the middleweight division.

A large, long-tailed game bird.
We saw a beautiful pheasant in the field.

A small flute.
The piccolo has a very high-pitched sound.

The act of delaying something.
The postponement of the meeting was due to bad weather.

A cat (informal); a thick yellowish or greenish opaque liquid produced in infected tissue.
The little puss curled up on the sofa.

The state or quality of being regular.
He exercised with great regularity.

A temporary structure used to support workers and materials during the construction or repair of a building.
The workers erected a scaffold around the building.

An animal that feeds on carrion, dead plant material, or refuse.
Vultures are known as scavengers.

The entertainment industry.
She always dreamed of a career in showbiz.

a type of bird
A large flock of starlings flew overhead at dusk.

the state of being enough
They aimed for self-sufficiency in food production.

an act of bringing down or defeating
The wrestler executed a perfect takedown.

a device that displays information; a heart
The stock market ticker showed the latest prices.

a slight argument
They had a little tiff over who should do the dishes.

a clear protective coating
She applied a coat of varnish to the wooden table.

a playful or humorous person
He's quite a wag, always making jokes.

a man whose wife has died and who has not remarried
After his wife passed away, he became a widower.

a sudden, forceful pull
With a quick yank, he opened the stubborn drawer.

a person who flies or is trained to fly an aircraft
The airman completed his training last month.

a sausage; an old car; a great song
We had sausages and mash, or 'bangers and mash' as they call it here.

A type of dark, fine-grained volcanic rock.
The Giant's Causeway is famous for its hexagonal basalt columns.

The act or process of improving something.
The organization works for the betterment of society.

A particular right of possession or privilege that someone has from birth.
Freedom of speech is considered a fundamental birthright.

Water that has been contaminated by human waste.
Proper treatment of blackwater is essential for public health.

A North American tree or shrub of the horse chestnut family.
The buckeye is the state tree of Ohio.

A rule made by a local authority or corporation.
The new bylaw prohibits parking on this street.

The area from which rainfall flows into a river, lake, or reservoir.
The city's water supply comes from a large catchment area.

An edible seed from a plant in the mint family, rich in omega-3 fatty acids.
Chia seeds are often added to smoothies and yogurts.

A representation of Christ on the cross.
A small crucifix hung on the wall above her bed.

A general term for disorders that involve difficulty in learning to read or interpret words, letters, and other symbols.
Children with dyslexia may need special educational support.

A person who leaves their own country in order to settle permanently in another.
Many emigrants sent money back to their families.

the time or date (twice each year) at which the sun crosses the celestial equator, when day and night are of equal length
The vernal equinox marks the beginning of spring.

a speech or piece of writing that praises someone or something highly, typically someone who has just died
His son delivered a heartfelt eulogy at the funeral.

the ability to speak or write a particular foreign language easily and accurately
Achieving fluency in a second language takes time and practice.

a sugar found especially in fruit and honey
Many fruits are high in natural fructose.

a style of rock music characterized by a raucous guitar sound and apathetic or angst-filled lyrics; a style of fashion characterized by a deliberately unkempt look
Nirvana was a pioneering band in the grunge music scene.

a sudden, strong, and unpleasant shock or movement
The car hit a pothole and gave us a sudden jolt.

a flammable hydrocarbon liquid used as fuel
The lamp burned brightly with kerosene.

a motif of two or more letters, typically a person's initials, interwoven or combined into one design
The towels were embroidered with a beautiful monogram.

a type of large, predatory eel
Divers spotted a large moray eel hiding in the coral.

a man of noble birth or rank
The nobleman owned vast estates in the countryside.

a person who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future
She's such an optimist; she always sees the good in every situation.

the excessive or harmful use of something
The overuse of antibiotics can lead to drug resistance.

a thick yellowish or greenish opaque liquid produced in infected tissue
The doctor drained the pus from the infected wound.

a barrier placed across a road to stop or slow traffic; an obstacle
Negotiations hit a roadblock over funding issues.

a promotional tour or series of events
The band went on a roadshow to promote their new album.

a device for changing gear in a vehicle; a person or thing that shifts
He pushed the gear shifter into reverse.

deficit; shortage
There was a significant shortfall in the expected revenue.

a tower for storing grain; a system that operates in isolation
The farm had several large silos for corn.

black powdery substance from burning
The chimney was covered in black soot.

a tiny spot or piece
There was a tiny speck of dust on the lens.

a pen-like instrument for touchscreens or records
He used a stylus to draw on his tablet.

the hinged board at the back of a vehicle
He lowered the tailgate of the truck to load the boxes.

a ballet dancer's costume
The ballerina wore a pink tutu.

a substance diffused or suspended in the air
Steam is a form of water vapour.

a tree or shrub of warm climates
The acacia tree has beautiful yellow flowers.
